Summary

PRVSAN01 is a batch sanctions and termination processor that reads incoming sanction records and applies exclusions, suspensions, or reinstatements to provider master records. For each sanction action processed, the program updates the provider's status on the Provider Master file and dynamically invokes an appropriate notice-generation program to notify downstream systems such as Claims and MCO. It is a standalone batch main program with no CICS interaction.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed and Sequential Files) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Sanction Input Processing - Read each sanction record sequentially from the incoming sanctions file, extracting the provider NPI, action code (Terminate/Suspend/Reinstate), reason, and effective date for processing 2: Provider Lookup by NPI - Search the Provider Master file using the NPI from the sanction record to retrieve the provider's current record for status update 3: Provider Not Found Handling - When a provider NPI from the sanction input does not exist in the Provider Master, log the unmatched NPI and skip processing for that record 4: Provider Termination - When the sanction action is Terminate, update the provider's status in the Provider Master to Terminated and increment the termination counter 5: Provider Suspension - When the sanction action is Suspend, update the provider's status in the Provider Master to Denied/Suspended, preventing the provider from receiving claims or services 6: Provider Reinstatement - When the sanction action is Reinstate, update the provider's status in the Provider Master back to Active, restoring the provider's eligibility 7: Provider Master Record Update - Persist the updated provider status (Terminated, Suspended, or Active) back to the Provider Master file after applying the sanction action 8: Sanction Notice Generation - Based on the sanction action type (Termination, Suspension, or Reinstatement), invoke the appropriate notice program to generate and send notifications to downstream systems such as Claims and MCO 9: Termination Count Reporting - Track and display the total number of providers terminated during the processing run for audit and reporting purposes

Datasource Information (2)

Datasource Name Type Usage
PRV-MASTER-FILE VSAM INDEXED (KSDS) Read and updated (REWRITE) to apply sanction actions — termination, suspension, or reinstatement — to provider master records keyed by NPI
SANCTION-IN-FILE Sequential File Input file read sequentially to obtain sanction instructions, including provider NPI, action code (Terminate/Suspend/Reinstate), reason, and effective date

High level flow diagram

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Sequential Sanction Record Reading-L_1: ```cobol READ SANCTION-IN-FILE MOVE WS-SAN-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ``` Provider Lookup by NPI-L_2: ```cobol MOVE SAN-NPI TO PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD READ PRV-MASTER-FILE ``` Unmatched Provider NPI Handling-L_3: ```cobol IF WS-PRV-STATUS = '00' PERFORM APPLY-SANCTION ELSE DISPLAY 'PRVSAN01: NPI NOT FOUND ' SAN-NPI END-IF ``` Provider Termination Status Update-L_4: ```cobol WHEN SAN-TERMINATE SET PRV-TERMINATED OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO TRUE ADD 1 TO WS-TERM-COUNT ``` Provider Suspension Status Update-L_5: ```cobol WHEN SAN-SUSPEND SET PRV-DENIED OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO TRUE ``` Provider Reinstatement Status Restoration-L_6: ```cobol WHEN SAN-REINSTATE SET PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO TRUE ``` Provider Master Record Persistence After Sanction-L_7: ```cobol REWRITE PRV-MASTER-RECORD ``` Sanction Notice Program Selection and Invocation-L_8: ```cobol EVALUATE TRUE WHEN SAN-TERMINATE MOVE 'TRM' TO WS-NOTICE-SUFFIX WHEN SAN-SUSPEND MOVE 'SUS' TO WS-NOTICE-SUFFIX WHEN SAN-REINSTATE MOVE 'RST' TO WS-NOTICE-SUFFIX WHEN OTHER MOVE 'GEN' TO WS-NOTICE-SUFFIX END-EVALUATE STRING WS-NOTICE-PREFIX DELIMITED SIZE WS-NOTICE-SUFFIX DELIMITED SIZE INTO WS-NOTICE-PGM CALL WS-NOTICE-PGM USING PRV-MASTER-RECORD ``` Notice Program Not Found Handling-L_9: ```cobol CALL WS-NOTICE-PGM USING PRV-MASTER-RECORD ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'PRVSAN01: NOTICE PGM NOT FOUND ' WS-NOTICE-PGM END-CALL ``` Termination Count Summary Reporting-L_10: ```cobol ADD 1 TO WS-TERM-COUNT ... DISPLAY 'PRVSAN01: PROVIDERS TERMINATED=' WS-TERM-COUNT ```

1: Sanction Input Processing

Business Rules

Supporting Code

BR-SIP-01 Sequential Processing of Sanction Input Records - L6, L8-L9: ```cobol PERFORM PROCESS-SANCTION UNTIL WS-END-OF-FILE ... READ SANCTION-IN-FILE MOVE WS-SAN-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS ``` BR-SIP-02 Detect End of Sanctions File and Stop Processing - L9-L11: ```cobol MOVE WS-SAN-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ``` BR-SIP-03 Extract Provider NPI from Sanction Record - L13: ```cobol MOVE SAN-NPI TO PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD ``` BR-SIP-04 Validate Sanction Action Code as TERMINATE - L20-L22: ```cobol EVALUATE TRUE WHEN SAN-TERMINATE SET PRV-TERMINATED OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO TRUE ADD 1 TO WS-TERM-COUNT ``` BR-SIP-05 Validate Sanction Action Code as SUSPEND - L23-L24: ```cobol WHEN SAN-SUSPEND SET PRV-DENIED OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO TRUE ``` BR-SIP-06 Validate Sanction Action Code as REINSTATE - L25-L26: ```cobol WHEN SAN-REINSTATE SET PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO TRUE ``` BR-SIP-07 Pass Validated Sanction Record for Provider Lookup and Status Update - L13-L18: ```cobol MOVE SAN-NPI TO PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD READ PRV-MASTER-FILE IF WS-PRV-STATUS = '00' PERFORM APPLY-SANCTION ELSE DISPLAY 'PRVSAN01: NPI NOT FOUND ' SAN-NPI END-IF ```
